## MR CAUSE
- CAUSE is used to address issues of correlated pleiotropy and is more robust
- note, we need loo@2.9.0 for this to work without compatibility issues

```{r load libraries and directories, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(cause)
library(dplyr)
library(ieugwasr)

PLINK_BIN <- "/vast/palmer/apps/avx2/software/PLINK/1.9b_6.21-x86_64/plink"
LD_BFILE <- "/gpfs/gibbs/pi/polimanti/LDSC_1000G/g1000_eur"


```

#### Checking Loneliness <-> Triglycerides

```{r loading loneliness and tg, eval=FALSE, cache=TRUE, include=FALSE}
PATH_PAN_LONELY <- "/vast/palmer/scratch/polimanti/ejm96/metal_ldsc_pipeline/primary_clean/005_Loneliness_isolation_PanUKB_clean.tsv.gz"
loneliness <- read_tsv(PATH_PAN_LONELY)

PATH_TG <- "/vast/palmer/scratch/polimanti/ejm96/metal_ldsc_pipeline/metal_ivw/Triglycerides_METAL_combined.tsv.gz"
tg <- read_tsv(PATH_TG)

PATH_T2D <- "/vast/palmer/scratch/polimanti/ejm96/metal_ldsc_pipeline/primary_clean/006_Type_2_Diabetes_clean.tsv.gz"
t2d <- read_tsv(PATH_T2D)

colnames(loneliness)
colnames(tg)
colnames(t2d)
```


```{r checking colnames, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
head(loneliness)
head(tg)

```

#### Format Loneliness to Triglycerides
```{r harmonizing and formatting}
lone_tg <- cause::gwas_merge(
  loneliness,
  tg,
  snp_name_cols = c("SNP", "SNP"),
  beta_hat_cols = c("BETA", "BETA"),
  se_cols = c("SE", "SE"),
  A1_cols = c("A1", "A1"),
  A2_cols = c("A2", "A2")
)

saveRDS(lone_tg, "/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/immune/results/two_sample_mr/lone_tg.rds")
```

```{r check formatting, echo=FALSE}
head(lone_tg)

names(lone_tg)

# compute p-values
lone_tg$p1 <- 2 * pnorm(
  -abs(lone_tg$beta_hat_1 / lone_tg$seb1)
)

head(lone_tg)
```

#### Estimate Parameters for MR CAUSE


```{r MR CAUSE parameter estimation, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
set.seed(100)
varlist <- with(lone_tg, sample(snp, size=1000000, replace=FALSE))
params <- est_cause_params(lone_tg, varlist)

saveRDS(
  params,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "CAUSE_params_lone_tg.rds")
)
```

```{r show params, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
names(params)
params$rho
```

```{r reload parameter estiamtes, echo=FALSE}

params <- readRDS("/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/immune/results/two_sample_mr/CAUSE_params_lone_tg.rds")


```


#### Clumping
- uses the tutorial threshold value because CAUSE can take weaker instruments because of how it models a shared factor


```{r clumping threshold, eval=FALSE, cache=TRUE, include=FALSE}
lone_tg <- readRDS("/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/immune/results/two_sample_mr/lone_tg.rds")

ld_input <- data.frame(
  rsid = lone_tg$snp,
  pval = lone_tg$p1,
  id = "loneliness"
)

ld_input <- ld_input[
  !is.na(ld_input$rsid) &
    !duplicated(ld_input$rsid) &
    is.finite(ld_input$pval),
]

clumped <- ieugwasr::ld_clump(
  dat = ld_input,
  clump_kb = 10000,
  clump_r2 = 0.01,
  clump_p = 1e-3,
  bfile = LD_BFILE,
  plink_bin = PLINK_BIN
)

top_vars <- clumped$rsid
```

```{r check vars}
length(top_vars)
head(top_vars)
```

#### CAUSE FIT

```{r cause fit, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
cause_lone_tg <- cause::cause(
  X = lone_tg,
  variants = top_vars,
  param_ests = params,
  pval_thresh = 1e-3
)


```

```{r show results lone tg, echo=TRUE}
summary(cause_lone_tg)
cause_lone_tg$elpd
plot(cause_lone_tg)
summary(cause_lone_tg, ci_size = 0.95)
```


- causal model from Loneliness -> Tg is a better fit (p = 0.0015)
- delta_elpd = −6.2, SE = 2.1, z = −3.0, p = 0.0015
- effect size of gamma = 0.06 (0.03, 0.09)
- estimated that 26% of the SNPs are acting through the shared factor
- visually, we can see that gamma is concentrated above zero (which is the causal effect estimate)
- we can see that eta (the parameter reflecting how much SNP effects are acting through shared factor) are distributed around zero


#### TG to Loneliness?
```{r harmonising tg lone, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
tg_lone <- cause::gwas_merge(
  tg,
  loneliness,
  snp_name_cols = c("SNP", "SNP"),
  beta_hat_cols = c("BETA", "BETA"),
  se_cols = c("SE", "SE"),
  A1_cols = c("A1", "A1"),
  A2_cols = c("A2", "A2")
)

tg_lone$p1 <- 2 * pnorm(
  -abs(tg_lone$beta_hat_1 / tg_lone$seb1)
)


saveRDS(tg_lone, "/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/immune/results/two_sample_mr/tg_lone.rds")


```

```{r parans for tg lone, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
set.seed(100)
varlist <- with(tg_lone, sample(snp, size=1000000, replace=FALSE))
params <- est_cause_params(tg_lone, varlist)

saveRDS(
  params,
  file.path("/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/immune/results/two_sample_mr/CAUSE_params_tg_lone.rds")
)
```

```{r clumping tg lone, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
ld_input <- data.frame(
  rsid = tg_lone$snp,
  pval = tg_lone$p1,
  id = "loneliness"
)

ld_input <- ld_input[
  !is.na(ld_input$rsid) &
    !duplicated(ld_input$rsid) &
    is.finite(ld_input$pval),
]

clumped <- ieugwasr::ld_clump(
  dat = ld_input,
  clump_kb = 10000,
  clump_r2 = 0.01,
  clump_p = 1e-3,
  bfile = LD_BFILE,
  plink_bin = PLINK_BIN
)

top_vars <- clumped$rsid
```

```{r CAUSE fit tg lone, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
cause_tg_lone <- cause::cause(
  X = tg_lone,
  variants = top_vars,
  param_ests = params,
  pval_thresh = 1e-3
)


```

```{r results tg lone, echo=TRUE}
summary(cause_tg_lone)
cause_tg_lone$elpd
plot(cause_tg_lone)
summary(cause_tg_lone, ci_size = 0.95)

saveRDS(cause_tg_lone, "/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/immune/results/two_sample_mr/cause_tg_lone.rds")

```
- also finds causal model from Tg -> loneliness is a better fit than the shared model (delta elpd= -4.05,	se = 1.70, z =	-2.38, p = 0.0086)
- Gamma causal model = 0.08 [0.05, 0.11], which is a stronger estimated causal effect than for Loneliness -> Tg

#### T2D to Triglycerides

```{r T2D to triglycerides harmonization}
t2d_tg <- cause::gwas_merge(
  t2d,
  tg,
  snp_name_cols = c("SNP", "SNP"),
  beta_hat_cols = c("BETA", "BETA"),
  se_cols = c("SE", "SE"),
  A1_cols = c("A1", "A1"),
  A2_cols = c("A2", "A2")
)

t2d_tg$p1 <- 2 * pnorm(
  -abs(t2d_tg$beta_hat_1 / t2d_tg$seb1)
)


saveRDS(t2d_tg, "/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/immune/results/two_sample_mr/cause/t2d_tg.rds")
```
```{r params t2d to tg}
set.seed(100)
varlist <- with(t2d_tg, sample(snp, size=1000000, replace=FALSE))
params <- est_cause_params(t2d_tg, varlist)

saveRDS(
  params,
  file.path("/gpfs/gibbs/project/polimanti/ejm96/immune/results/two_sample_mr/cause/CAUSE_params_t2d_tg.rds")
)
```
